children: The U.K.'s Debt Management Office sold 5 billion pounds ($6.77 billion) in new May 2030-dated gilts at an auction on Thursday, it said.
The following are results of the auction, with amounts in pounds.

Issue              4.625% May. 22, 2030 gilt 
Amount on offer    5.0  billion 
Bids received      16.2 billion 
Bids accepted      5.0  billion 
Bid-to-cover ratio 3.24 
Average yield      4.786% 
Average price      99.47 
Maximum yield      4.789% 
Yield Tail         0.3 Bps 
Settlement date    Sep. 11, 2026
